def find_length(s):
    n = len(s)
    arr = [1 if ch == '1' else -1 for ch in s]
    max_diff = arr[0]
    curr_max = arr[0]
    for i in range(1, n):
        curr_max = max(arr[i], curr_max + arr[i])
        max_diff = max(max_diff, curr_max)

    count[0][0] = 1
    
    for i in range(1, n):
        dp[i][0] = dp[i-1][0] + matrix[i][0]
        count[i][0] = count[i-1][0] + 1
        
    for j in range(1, n):
        dp[0][j] = dp[0][j-1] + matrix[0][j]
        count[0][j] = count[0][j-1] + 1
        
    for i in range(1, n):
        for j in range(1, n):
            from_top = dp[i-1][j] + matrix[i][j]
            from_left = dp[i][j-1] + matrix[i][j]
            count_top = count[i-1][j] + 1
            count_left = count[i][j-1] + 1
            
            avg_top = from_top / count_top
            avg_left = from_left / count_left
            
            if avg_top > avg_left:
                dp[i][j] = from_top
                count[i][j] = count_top
            else:
                dp[i][j] = from_left
                count[i][j] = count_left
                
    return dp[n-1][n-1] / count[n-1][n-1]
